games.name: Sky Rush
games.description: Race as birds down colorful slopes, build speed by sliding smoothly, and compete for best times with friends across diverse worlds like Mushroom, Grass, and Ice. Fun, fast-paced, and all about improving your record.

games.name: Tome Improvement
games.description: A co-op dungeon crawler where you and your friends name the spells. Catch critters, combine them in your staff, and hope your friends remember which spell is "DIVORCE BEAM" when you are surrounded by skeletons.

games.name: Keyboard Smash
games.description: Run a shop. Help weird customers. And definitely make everything worse!

games.name: Bird Poo Game
games.description: Cause chaos from the sky and profit underground. Drop poop on pedestrians to send them rushing to Bob's laundromat. Collect coins, upgrade machines, unlock explosive abilities, and build a bizarre laundry empire one splat at a time.

games.name: Radioactivity
games.description: Radioactivity is a co-op survival horror. You are a Liquidator! Together or alone, help your state clean up post-apocalyptic radioactive wilderness. Plan each deployment, fight radiation spread and the creatures that it produces. Together, make WEA flourish once more!

games.name: Catching Breaks
games.description: Catching Breaks is a darkly comedic office simulator where fixing problems is easy and dealing with people is not. Repair broken machines while coworkers interrupt you with pointless conversations, fake urgency, and corporate nonsense. Keep the office running long enough to survive another workday.

games.name: Please fix the mess
games.description: Clean up chaotic interiors, remove trash, repaint walls, and redecorate messy spaces, sometimes with a few suspiciously bodies lying around.

games.name: Zombie Industrial Complex
games.description: Exterminate zombies using the might of the military industrial complex. In this active incremental game, you'll earn money by defeating zombies which can be used to buy weapons, purchase upgrades, call in airstrikes, and send in the tanks!

games.name: StoryMode
games.description: StoryMode is a reading tool completely built around idle/incremental gameplay and progression. Add manga and books, earn experience, levels, and rewards as you read. Complete quests, discover companions, and personalize your reading experience with customizable themes and animated backgrounds.

games.name: Pumpkin Is Yummy!?
games.description: Your own little farm village, tucked into the corner of your desktop. Raise a chatty pumpkin, tend your crops, and collect critters in this quirky, lighthearted idler. How you raise your Pumpkin decides who they become.

games.name: DETRUST
games.description: DETRUST is an online co-op game for up to 12 players, built on teamwork and betrayal. You’ve been sent to repair a damaged facility before the scheduled decontamination begins. Complete tasks, stay alert, and try to escape alive… before one of you tries to kill the entire crew.

games.name: Silver Lake National Park
games.description: Welcome to Silver Lake National Park, where Ranger Logan keeps the trails clear, the campfires warm, and the supernatural community hidden in plain sight. He's a werebear who learned long ago not to fight what he is. These days he makes sure everyone feels at home, even when he can't always feel it.

games.name: Pakku Pony
games.description: Pakku Pony is a 2D virtual pet simulator where you raise your own pony! It’s a chill point-and-click game where you take care of your little garden, cook delicious dishes and relax with fun minigames. Oh, and don’t forget to look stylish with cosmetics and customization options!

games.name: Captain Speedfin
games.description: Captain Speedfin is stuck with an hourglass and needs to be fast! Race against the clock through 60 challenging levels of pirate parkour, where every second counts. Grab your treasure and get out before time runs out!

games.name: Wander Her Way VR
games.description: Explore incredible interactive locations with your gorgeous companion. A sandbox VR experience with mini-games. Shoot enemies, destroy objects, drive a car, dance with an amazing girl, defend a tower, catch mischievous kittens, watch a fireworks show. Realistic female character, advanced physics

games.name: Joaquin Simulator
games.description: Help retiree Joaquin on his road trip through Brazil. It's a 2000 km journey full of challenges, and nothing is simple in Brazil. You must eat, drink, smoke, earn money, deal with corrupt cops, all to reach a party to save democracy in Brazil.

games.name: Master of the Mow
games.description: Become the Master of the Mow. Cut grass, clear trash, and uncover buried treasures across the overgrown grounds of an old manor estate. Upgrade your tools and grow stronger with each trinket you sell and solve the mystery of why the grass grows back every morning. Can you finish it all in one day?

games.name: GUNtai
games.description: Craft your gun. Shoot down enemies hordes. Upgrade weapon, remake weapon, combine weapon. Unlock new characters and new modules. Make great gunsmiths regret their inventions!

games.name: Mech Assembler: Model Kit builder Simulator
games.description: Welcome to Mech Assembler, a relaxing puzzle game inspired by model kit (Gunpla) construction. You'll experience the relaxing process of building a model. Once assembled, you can paint it with Spry. Earn points based on your accuracy and unlock new elements.

games.name: Burger Rush Simulator
games.description: Burger Rush Simulator is a fast food simulator where you manage your fast food restaurant, order supplies, restock containers, take payments at checkout and drive-thru, prepare meals, hire staff, expand your kitchen and dining area, and unlock features like storage and touchscreen checkout.

games.name: Dreamcraft: Lumberjack
games.description: Chop the sick trees to purify the forests. Gather lumber, upgrade your axe, and improve stats. No rush, no stress, relax in cozy and beautiful lands, rescue animals, and unravel the secrets of the wilderness. Nature must be preserved so cut the shadow and restore the light!

games.name: Pinewater
games.description: Pinewater is a cozy first-person fishing game about restoring a run-down lakeside cabin. Catch rare and legendary fish, restore and decorate your lakeside home, plant trees, and shape the surroundings to your liking — all at your own pace.

games.name: Marble Run Maker
games.description: Build marble runs in a room with realistic physics. Stack random objects to make a wobbly track and watch the ball roll down! Explore puzzles with unlimited solutions.

games.name: Tiny Tree Talk
games.description: Grow and shape bonsai trees, build tiny dioramas, and find a new sense of belonging on TinyTreeTalk - a wholesome bonsai internet forum. Enjoy full sandbox freedom or bring requests to life as you grow your reputation, unlock new props, and enjoy chill lofi beats and a nostalgic mid-2000s Japan.

games.name: Sweep City
games.description: Keep your streets clean and discover hidden treasures in this relaxing street sweeper adventure. Drive through procedurally generated neighborhoods, uncover rare finds, and upgrade your sweeper with unique specializations. Cruise to your own tunes while keeping the city spotless.

games.name: CHARK
games.description: Chess and deckbuilding collide in a compact 5×5 roguelike battlefield of risk and reward. Build momentum from a lone King: stack small advantages, gamble on bold moves, and watch the rules bend as your King snowballs to victory. Short, intense runs how far can you go?

games.name: Kaiju Catastrophe
games.description: Crush, smash, and eat thousands of enemies showing humanity what the meaning of destruction is! Kaiju Catastrophe is an arcade game with roguelite mechanics. Mutate devastating weapons, unlock permanent evolutions, and wreak havoc with a variety of monsters to tear humanity apart!

games.name: Let's Drive - learn driving simulator
games.description: There are 1.3 billion cars in the world. But how many good drivers are there? Is every one of them trained and competent? Find out while playing Let's Drive, a driving school simulator that shows you hazardous situations on the road and puts you right in them.

games.name: Motorsport Park Manager
games.description: Build and customize your own motorsports park in this classic tycoon simulation. Start with local go-kart tracks and grassroots circuits, and grow into a world-renowned racing destination.

games.name: Red & Blue
games.description: Play as two housecats causing chaos while their owners are gone! Jump on each other, get chained to each other, and help each other solve color-coded puzzles.

games.name: Soundscapes
games.description: Soundscapes is an interactive music sandbox where your songs shape the world around you.

games.name: Loafing Dungeon
games.description: Loafing Dungeon is a fully automatic desktop idle game. Build your hero team on the desktop, equip them with gear and skills, and then launch the adventure on auto-pilot. The game runs continuously in the background, ensuring your progression and rewards are always fight, whether you're busy or free

games.name: Appetite for Destruction
games.description: Co-op in a fully destructible world. Meet the quota faster than your friends - or stop them from doing it. Use physics and tools to survive the escalating chaos, or switch to Sandbox mode with no limits.

games.name: Deep Hunger
games.description: A short incremental game about cleaning the ocean, and feeding the insatiable hunger of a deep sea creature.

games.name: One Wrong Step
games.description: One wrong move can change everything... Explore trapped rooms in this tactical roguelite inspired by Minesweeper. Every square is a risk. Every exit, a choice. Think carefully... or start again.

games.name: Purrfect Collars
games.description: Purrfect Collars is a cozy single-player shopkeeping adventure. As a witch, design collars, enchant them with potions, manage your shop and meet interesting new customers! Each collar holds meaning, every cat a story!

games.name: Meal Quest
games.description: Explore the magical world inside your fridge, plan meals, and fight your way to the Dream City. Your in-game nutrition choices grant you combat bonuses that reflect each vitamin’s actual role in the body.

games.name: Drawing Dead
games.description: Drawing Dead is a roguelike deckbuilder with an occult personality. Swap cards on a 5×5 grid to form hands, bind legions of demons with game-changing powers, and enchant your deck into an infernal scoring engine.

games.name: SlopTuber Simulator
games.description: SlopTuber Simulator is a short incremental adventure about filling the internet with worthless video content for fun and profit (Mostly for profit)!

games.name: DIGI-DOLL
games.description: Mauve takes on the job of a decorator. Design and decorate dollhouses for different ragdolls and appease their unique tastes. Use the retro DIGI-DOLL console to explore the attic, unlock various dollhouses, befriend characters, and discover stunning furnishings to fill them with.

games.name: The Haunting of the Chea-Wilson Family
games.description: A Cambodian-American family becomes haunted by a ghost. Enjoy this story-driven narrative as the haunting unfolds. Inspired by horror movies in the late 2000s-2010s.

games.name: Hell Loop
games.description: A rogue-like dungeon crawler with Chinese mythic horror. Play as an ancient butcher, trapped in the cycles of the underworld. Seek redemption, gain the aid of heavenly gods, and fight for freedom—and for the wife you still love.

games.name: Goop Up!
games.description: A vibrant and mysterious world filled with enchanted hats, oozing clumps of slime, hidden pathways, and a terrible king. Follow the trail of adventure to defeat the king and save the world from his tyrannical rule!

games.name: Yuki-Tundra
games.description: Build your store empire, help the local community and keep the shelves stocked in a bid to boost your stores reputation while you rise from the ashes. Yuki-Tundra blends the casual store management genre with classic RPG adventures.

games.name: Heretic Red
games.description: In this story-rich detective game, uncover clues through a card-like system to solve a series of bizarre murders. Combine pieces of evidence to build your case against the most likely culprit from within an eclectic cast of unusual characters.

games.name: PLEASE KNOCK: The Sloppy Researcher's Life
games.description: PLEASE KNOCK: The Sloppy Researcher’s Life is a top-down story adventure game about an unusual research life between a sloppy senior student and a helpful junior.

games.name: Kkokko Industry
games.description: Kkokko Industry is a relaxing idle game where you manage a chicken farm. The game runs on one side of your monitor, allowing you to enjoy it comfortably while working on other tasks.

games.name: Birdoo
games.description: Birdoo: Feathered Fury is an indie action game were you assume the role of a bird embarking on a quest for revenge against the humans who wronged him. No longer will you tolerate being called a "flying rat" or being shooed away. It's time to exact your revenge!

games.name: Hand Shadow
games.description: Challenge your mind with puzzles that are based on optical illusions. Find the perfect position and angle by rotating the hands until order is restored, and discover a story of protagonist Morgan with professional voicing.

games.name: Crimson Crisis
games.description: A fast-paced action roguelike where skill beats firepower. Outmaneuver swarms, harness Poison/Inflame/Traumatize, and expand the game with mods & co-op.

games.name: Rodent Rampage
games.description: Rodent Rampage is a third-person hero shooter. Combine nitrous boosted ground maneuvers, soda powered aerial attacks, and quirky in game power ups in a one-of-a-kind, PvP combat experience.

games.name: Bite the Crown
games.description: In a world ruled by sugary tyrants, an unlikely hero rises from the shadows: Pom the Mold. Build your secret guild, gather rogue treats, lead the rebellion and battle through candy-coated chaos to topple the Candy Kingdom. The Sweet Revolution begins—bite back!

games.name: Valkyrie Iteration: Mecha Pilot Raising Pocket Simulator
games.description: Step into the role of a technomaster in Valkyrie Iteration, a sci-fi visual novel. Train and guide Lana, a young pilot, and her sentient mech, the Valkyrie, as they prepare for high-stakes battles against otherworldly foes.

games.name: Beam Them All
games.description: An incremental strategy about cosmic hunting: pilot your flying saucer, abduct animals with a tractor beam, and gather biomass to unlock new technologies. Upgrade your ship, expand the field, and evacuate in time before turrets and mines cut your expedition short.

games.name: Yes Chef!
games.description: There's never a calm day in this kitchen! A first-person co-op restaurant game for 1-6 players. Pick burgers, steak, pizza, breakfast or salad, cook, serve and rush to save the burning dish. Can you reach the final day before your customers lose patience? If you fail, everything resets.

games.name: Island Shuffle
games.description: Build little islands, your way. Combine buildings and upgrades, enjoy colorful scenery, and watch your score grow.
